name: IDXNet
summary: Dialup ISP (idx.com.au, est. ~1996-97); defunct (IDXNET COMPUTING PTY LIMITED, ACN 070 515 481).

events.details: Defunct. IDX-branded portal last alive Feb 2010 and third-party-operated by Feb 2012, promoting the 'c. 2012' proposal over the current c. 2001. IDX-branded portal handed to a third party.

refs.label: Feb 2010: the IDXNet-branded ISP portal still live at idx.com.au.
By Feb 2012 the same template portal runs with an unrelated third-party contact (tripleplayhub.com) - IDXNET identity gone.
